refactor(tests): nine test monoliths mirror the source monoliths — doctor.test.ts (2,206), service-manifest.test.ts (2,161), upgrade.test.ts (2,099), tools.test.ts (2,045), up.test.ts (1,895, 109 mocks), down.test.ts (1,489), template-engine.test.ts (1,481), native-runtime.test.ts (1,391), resource.test.ts (1,325); split each with its source so per-module suites replace whole-command mocking

refactor(cli): cli/src/utils/project-repos.ts is 523 lines — the three jobs of `flisk repos` (validate the list, clone what is missing, report what drifted) live in one module: `validateRepoUrl` (+29), `validateRepoDir` (+73), `validateRepoList` (+83), `cloneRepo` (+97), `cloneMissingRepos` (+26), `checkProjectRepos` (+120); split validation, cloning and the drift report so each is testable alone

refactor(agents): cli/src/agent-runtimes/custom.ts is 643 lines and `getCustomAgentIndexTemplate` (L11, +634) is one function — a single 634-line string-builder for the custom-agent index template; split it into template fragments (or move the body to a template file) so the generator is small and the template is diffable

refactor(cli): cli/src/utils/service-manifest.ts is 918 lines — the nine field-slice modules exist (service-manifest-{ports,container,depends-on,volumes,providers,...}.ts) but the hub still holds validateServiceManifest (+126), healthCheckErrors (+93), sidecarErrors (+89), validateGeneratedStringFields (+75) and five more; finish the split so each validator lives with its field

refactor(cli): cli/src/utils/service-config-checks.ts is 1,023 lines — eight service-config checks live in one file by host layer (checkDockerfilePorts L662 +157, checkRequiredSecrets +98, checkNetworkPorts +93, checkServicePorts +83, checkModelRunner +50, checkSchemaVersions +41, enforceServiceConfigGate +40, checkGpuRuntime +39); split them into `service-config-checks/` concept modules like #4881 did for doctor-wiring

refactor(cli): cli/src/commands/status.ts is 702 lines — `strictNotReady` at L57 spans +646 (~the whole file) and the action mixes "is this service ready" probes with status printing and exit-code logic; extract `strictNotReady` + its probing helpers into `commands/status/not-ready.ts`, and the rest into `commands/status/action.ts`

refactor(utils): cli/src/utils/distribution.ts is 943 lines — `buildBoard` (L433, +182), `buildKit` (L759, +169) and `buildStatusGrid`/`formatStatusGrid`/`formatBoard` are three near-parallel renderers of "the thing I can point a user to"; the whole "Board/kit/status" pipeline (readDistributionFile, readToolsAndPrompts, createInitialDistribution, buildBoard, buildKit, buildStatusGrid) lives in one file with no concept slices — split into `distribution/{board,kit,status,tools}.ts`

refactor(cli): cli/src/commands/project.ts is 1,022 lines — `printTemplateCatalog` spans L570-to-EOF (~450 lines: catalog JSON/markdown output + spawn hints) and the `projectCommand` action is ~L584-1022 (~440 lines): split into `project/template-catalog.ts` (catalog printing, `actionWordHint`, `exitUnknownTemplate`, `formatProjectPaths`), `project/clone.ts` (`cloneProjectTemplate`, `writeDefaultProjectConfig`), leaving `project.ts` as the Command shell

refactor(cli): cli/src/commands/down.ts is 735 lines — the action spans ~L338-735 (~400 lines) and mixes resolving/stopping every runtime (Tilt, native supervisor, Docker) with verification; split into `down/` modules: `stop.ts` (stop every runtime, incl. native supervisor + docker-compose down), `verify.ts` (verify the stop), `find.ts` (project + tilt resolution), thin action in down.ts

refactor(doctor): cli/src/commands/doctor.ts is 850 lines — the `doctorCommand` action spans ~277-850 (~574 lines) and mixes environment checks (Docker/Tilt/ports), stack checks (Dockerfile ports, health-route probes) and the check runner itself — split the action into `doctor/` modules: `run-checks.ts` (the runner over the check registry), `checks/` (per-concept modules), `fix.ts` (the fix plan)

refactor(doctor): cli/src/utils/doctor-runtime.ts is 1,409 lines and mixes the Tilt-resource check, port checks and process probes without any shared seam — extract `findStaleDisabledResources` (L174, +155), `checkTiltResourceHealth` (L1039, +131), `checkIngressPorts` (L654, +126), `checkPrivateNpmRegistry` (L534, +120), `checkHostPorts` (L924, +115) and their host-probing helpers into a single `doctor/tilt-runtime.ts` core, and the rest of the file (health/readiness probes, Native Windows) into `doctor/process.ts`

refactor(mcp): cli/src/mcp/tools.ts L822 `createFliskTools` is a ~620-line function building all tool definitions by hand — move the definitions to a data table (name, description, inputSchema, run) and slice one focused handler module per tool family (up/down/status/resource/stack/project/config/logs)

refactor(cli): cli/src/commands/config.ts is 858 lines — `configCommand` spans L100-L858 (~750 lines, all subcommand definitions + the regenerate action + infra-toggle logic) — split into config/ modules: plan.ts (regeneratePlan + RegenerateChange), regenerate-action.ts, infra-toggle.ts (toggleInfraService + infraToggleCommand), config.ts (the Command shell)
